Specification: This specification is a small test module for TLA+ action-subscript operators, specifically the box-style form [A]_e and the angle-bracket form <<A>>_e. It defines two variables x and y, initializes both to 1, and then uses a Next action with several branches that check whether stuttering and non-stuttering action formulas over different state expressions evaluate as expected. The module uses TLC-specific operators Print and Assert to validate these semantic cases rather than modeling a fault-tolerant protocol or distributed algorithm, and it includes a trivial invariant Inv == TRUE.
IfThenElse: IF [x # x]_<<x,y>> THEN Print("Test1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
IF <<Act1>>_<<x,y>> THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed") ELSE Print("Test2 OK", TRUE)
